description: Solar Energy Generation is a dataset listed in City of Port Phillip's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Port Phillip City. Solar Energy Generation at Councils' sites. The data is pulled from Port Phillip SolarEdge API. The dataset is updated every 1 hour. Coverage: Port Phillip, Victoria. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are solar, energy. The portal shows 49,344 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-portphillip-vic-gov-au-portal.
